map.长方体 V=L·W·D；梯形截面 V=(上底宽+下底宽)/2×深×长（含边坡时上: Cuboid V=L·W·D; trapezoidal section V=(top width+bottom width)/2×depth×length (with a slope, top width = bottom width + 2·depth·slope); cylinder V=πR²H, frustum V=πH/3·(R₁²+R₁R₂+R₂²); loose volume = in-situ volume × swell factor; cost = in-situ volume × unit price.

map.实方和虚方为什么差 1.3 倍？: Why do the in-situ and loose volumes differ by a factor of 1.3?
map.土石开挖后孔隙增多、体积膨胀，松散系数/可松性系数 swell 描述这一膨胀（一: After excavation the pore space increases and the material bulks up; the swell/loosenability factor swell describes this bulking (generally 1.2–1.3 for soil, larger for rock). In-situ volume = original volume, loose volume = volume of the loose pile after excavation. Transport and waste dump capacity are counted by the loose volume, while quantity settlement often uses the in-situ volume; the two must not be mixed.
